notes.title: Major FREE Update ‘Shrimplosion’ update is OUT!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,



It’s been a while since our last post, because we’ve been busy cooking something special for you!

We’re so excited to share our brand-new free Update ‘Shrimplosion’- this one’s for those of you who love tiny pet chaos (and that space shrimp video)!



You can see the famous Shrimp band in action in the trailer below:
[previewyoutube="nPnQTyrqoFo;full"][/previewyoutube]


Here’s what’s swimming your way:

🦐 The Shrimplosion is in town! A legendary music band of 4 shrimps can now be obtained, and will even start playing their hit song once they’re placed in your aquarium. 

💰 New shop tab, with a wide array of items (including mutators 👀) and exclusive decorations!

🐚 Fishing cosmetics shop, where you can buy cool new ship skins and effects using shells!

🐠 15 new fish and shellfish species, including the sea bunny 🐰
(Full list: Blue Crayfish, Amano Shrimp, Babaulti Shrimp, Blue Velvet Shrimp, Crystal Red Shrimp, Ghost Shrimp, Mantis Shrimp, Common Jellyfish, Flying Fish, Sea Bunny, Magical Magmafish, and The Shrimplosion band!).

🎁 15 new tank decorations
(Full list: Golden Chest, Blue Crystal, Pink Crystal, Runic Stone, Rock Cave, Clay Pot, Moss Balls, Stacked Stones, and 5 New Seaweed and wood Types).

🧼 Introducing the Instaclean: a new tank tool that’ll clean your aquarium in one swipe

🎉 +1 new aquarium tank!

📍 New quests, and a bigger quest pool! 



We’ve also had a lot of requests for it, so we’re bringing back the time-limited Axolotl Event! If you didn’t get one before, now is your chance to make your tank that much cuter! ♥️

As always, we would like to extend a huge thank you to our amazing community. Your creations and feedback are always a source of inspiration for our updates 🙂. We can’t wait to see how you customise your tanks, now with tiny concerts!



Best fishes!
- Can & Egon from the Lunheim Team 🐙

notes.title: Get the Supporter's Pack now! Comes with a shiny ✨Shell Pedestal✨
notes.content:
Hey all!


We want to say a big thank you to all of you who have bought our little game! It’s been amazing to see your creations and hear your thoughts! We now have over 1,000 reviews at 96% Overwhelmingly Positive so we are very pleased and grateful😊

We have now set up a Supporters Pack for those of you who would like to support the game and us as indie devs even more! This pack includes the highly sought after (by our publisher friends) and critically acclaimed (by us) Shell Pedestal, which of course will sparkle and glow and make your tank look extra special for when visitors stop by 🤩



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/6b690135b00fcb7488b1ad89a9d58d90dc260593.gif"]



And to celebrate this expansion pack, we've also just rolled out the 1.9 FREE update! You'll find the following:

🐟2 new friendly fish species added to the game

🥚Golden Arowana: Very rare hatch from the Exotic Eggs.

🐬Bubble Eggs & Bubble Dolphin: A new egg that hatches into the Bubble Dolphin. Very rare drop from popping bubbles.

🌊+1 new aquarium

🚢Sunken ship decoration: New decorative item added to shop rotation

🗿Stone pebble and Golden pebble: fishing drop

♥️And a bunch of quality of life additions, you can read the full patch notes we sent as a seperate announcement! 

Please note that this update mainly focuses on fixing bugs and introducing some QoL improvements. Our first major content update is still in the works.



And because we're feeling fancy, 🐬The Marine Life Conservation Event is now live until the 11th of August!

Release endangered species to gain special currency

Hatch 3 new special blue fish

Hatch 4 new endangered species from around the world

Get cool new decorations



We hope you enjoy these additions, and we look forward to seeing your even sparklier tanks!



Best fishes!
 - Can & Egon from the Lunheim Team 🐙

notes.title: 1.6.1 Now Live
notes.content:
**Tiny Aquarium – Update 1.6.1 Now Live! ** 


Tiny Aquarium 1.6.1 is now officially live! Thanks to everyone who helped test during the beta phase. Here’s what’s new in this mostly bug-fixing update:

notes.title: A “Thank YOU!” content update 🙂 New fish, new decorations
notes.content:
Hey everyone,


What a wild week it’s been!


Since launching on Monday, we’ve already sold over 25,000 copies, and our little aquarium game now has more than 400 reviews with a “Very Positive” rating on Steam 🥰


Your warm reception has been truly humbling. We honestly never expected so many of you would play our cozy little game - in fact, things got so unexpectedly busy that our servers crashed, and Egon had to pull an all-nighter to fix them!
To make up for it, we’ll be extending the Axolotl event for an extra week so nobody misses out because of the hiccups.

notes.title: 1.5 Now Available For Early Testing!
notes.content:
Hello Fishkeeper!

 v1.5 is live for testing! 

From now on, every patch will first go to a public beta branch a few hours (or a day for big updates) before the main version. Players who want early access and can help test are welcome to join. Use ⁠public-beta-feedback to give us feedback and report bugs. 

To access the beta: Right-click Tiny Aquarium in your Steam library → Properties → Betas → Select "publicbeta" from the dropdown.

 If you join the beta to help us find bugs, we recommend making a backup of your save file beforehand.
You can find it here:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Lunheim Studios/Tiny Aquarium 

If you received any new content in the beta branch of 1.5, do not switch back to the public branch until the 1.5 update is public. If you really want to, use your backup save in case anything goes wrong. 

--- 
Added,
An automatic backup system that restores your save after crashes or force quits,

3 new decorations to get from fishing with no bait,

2 new fish exclusive to some baits (Bluegill and Sturgeon),

 
Fixes,
Axolotl quests not giving coins,

Added a feature to remove previously created duplicate fish,

Fixed duplicate fish spawning after an online sale,

Time potions not reducing breeding cooldowns,

macOS icon glitches,

 
Changes,
Buffed coral fish,

Humphead made smaller, dolphin made bigger,

Updated clown triggerfish conservation status,

Adjusted quest and bait balance,

 --- 

As a thank-you for your patience during the event quest issues, every player will receive 500 axolotl coins upon launching the game.

Hey everyone,



We’re typing this down while we’re both overhyped and exhausted after launching the game earlier today 🥳Thank you so much for the warm reception, you have no idea how much it means to us to see the lobbies filled with people, chatting, sharing and fishing!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/ba935fbf04e3154c36901ce5add708c5f41c197a.png"]

Also, today marks the first day of our time-limited season event,  the “A-lotl Axolotl”!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/ad55e1c8af837e89524a5361339e00a3efa0b80f.png"]

That’s all for now, but before we leave you, we do have a small request - if you’re playing the game, would you consider leaving us a review? The mighty Steam algorithm puts a lot of importance on them, and this can make such a difference for small teams and projects like ours!

Best fishes and see you soon for more aquatic updates!
- Can & Egon from the Lunheim Team 🐙

notes.title: Welcome to Tiny Aquarium!
notes.content:
Hello all,

We are Lunheim Studios and this is our brand new game Tiny Aquarium: Social Fishkeeping! 

[previewyoutube=f8amATSCcq0;full][/previewyoutube]

Tiny Aquarium is a real-time idle aquarium sim that keeps growing even when you’re away! It can also accompany you throughout the day in a small box anywhere on your screen when in Tiny Mode, so you will never feel alone as you browse!

We’re super excited to be officially announcing this new  project, with a demo that you can go check out right now!! We’re also joined by Future Friends Games, who are helping us publish Tiny Aquarium 🧡

What you can expect from the demo:

 A place to create your dream aquarium, discovering new species of fish and unlocking new decorations to make them feel at home.
 A chilled hangout spot for you and your friends where you can visit each other's tanks and leave a reaction to let them know you popped by!
 A comforting companion on your screen, where fishies peacefully swim and enjoy your creation!
 Oh and A FISHING MINI GAME! 🎣


We really hope you enjoy this demo, make sure to wishlist the game so that you get notified with more updates, and follow us on Tiktok & Twitter for more Tiny Aquarium content! 💌

Talk soon!
The Lunheim Team



Played the older version of the demo?
No worries, your old aquarium is still safe! To access it, simply switch to the "legacy" branch. Here’s how:

 Open your Steam Library and find Tiny Aquarium.

 Right-click the game title and select Properties.

 Go to the Betas tab.

 In the dropdown menu, select "legacy".

 Close the window. Steam will automatically update your game to the legacy version.

Now you can revisit your original tank just as you left it!
